properties.name: scrollbar-width
properties.description: Sets the width of the scrollbar. Used for theming custom scrollbars in modern browsers (Firefox, Chrome 121+); older WebKit browsers are handled via ::-webkit-scrollbar rules.

properties.name: scrollbar-color
properties.description: Sets the color of the scrollbar thumb and track. Used for theming custom scrollbars in modern browsers (Firefox, Chrome 121+); older WebKit browsers are handled via ::-webkit-scrollbar rules.
